scope: A read-only history reconstruction; no trading strategy, orders, credentials or ON/LIVE changes
cause: Seven-day allOrders window grouped earlier reductions with later additions on one TRX position and incorrectly classified it as fully closed
repair: Preserved original data in raw.history_validation; marked invalid completion stale with unverified realized PnL null. Not a claim that real partial realized losses disappeared.
guards: Do not infer full closure while same position ID is live
Require equal opening/closing quantities instead of accepting excess closes from truncated history
Require chronological first opening and final closing
Do not persist or match backwards closed lifecycles into internal trade settlements
